kindNotes: hud.action-dock: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)
hud.crisis-icons: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)
hud.event-chips: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)

hud.action-dock.data: build, ledger, steward (undo when a site is new)

hud.crisis-icons.data: the famine's alerts (at most three bells)

slot.ledger.steward.data: the stone town's stocks with the steward's advice open

slot.ledger.steward-concern.data: the famine's alerts with the steward's warning open

slot.ledger.rights.data: chapter 4's rights register (charter rights, fee farm, revolt pressure)

slot.ledger.rights-decline.data: chapter 2's register after a right is lost

slot.ledger.wage.data: chapter 3's wage ledger under the stocks

modal.lord.home-petition.data: the boundary dispute (Wave 44 01), both answers' numbers

modal.lord.home-petition.guardian.data: a minor lord's wardship petition (the court line with his guardian)

modal.lord.registry.data: the first v4 offer the registry drew in the lord's slice: its why, each answer's tradeoff

modal.lord.registry-hold.data: the first v4 offer with a hold the lord can choose: the hold's cost in words under its tradeoff

lord.receipt.data: a town-built farmstead's receipt: five reasons, the next best site, the chance, the 10d subsidy and its decisions

lord.receipt-old.data: the same receipt from a save before the chance was kept

lord.receipt-none.data: the opening well: no receipt, the reason instead of an empty frame

lord.receipt-inspector.data: the first store's receipt (or why it has none) from the left inspector

slot.ledger.lord.data: the lord tab: the four policies (stability), the 10d farmstead subsidy, the draft and the dues at 80%

slot.ledger.lord-refusal.data: a subsidy draft past a quarter of the treasury: the reason written, the set button shut

lord.screen.data: the lord screen host over the town: the left menu (each shut item with its reason) and the screen (empty until an area opens one)

slot.ledger.lord-open.data: the ledger's lord tab with the way into the lord screens above the policies

lord.negotiation.draft.data: the marriage offer before any is sent: the grooms, the clause editor, the draft treaty (consent alone), the counterpart's tier and reasons, the refusal (no terms) under a shut offer button

lord.negotiation.counter.data: the counterpart's counter waiting a season: the clauses with the one it added marked, its tier and reasons, the deadline, accept and refuse as equal choices

lord.negotiation.will-change.data: the marriage's progress with the will change due: the events as they fell, the deferred debt, the contract's clauses under a stamped seal

lord.negotiation.contested.data: the estate contested after the will stood: the rival named, the outcome, the way to its suit on the ledger screen

lord.ledger.promises.data: the promise ledger with kept, broken and open debt instalments (the lord keeps them from the treasury), the lord's open claim

lord.ledger.empty.data: no promise yet (the marriage only offered): the empty ledger's lines, no timed terms, the lord's claim with its filing button

lord.ledger.suit.data: the contested inheritance's suit just filed: the stage track, the hearing's two sides, the five evidence kinds to bring; two claims to file

lord.ledger.neighbour.data: the lord's two closed suits (judged, enforced) and a neighbour's recovery suit against him, shown with no command

lord.estates.home.data: the estates screen on the home estate: the totals, the attention, the four estates to choose, the home card with its pieces and grants, the exceptions, the petitions

lord.estates.delegated.data: the inherited estate given to the greedy steward: its card with the overlay, the steward and the two other candidates, the audit by visit, its first season

lord.estates.overloaded.data: the same estate taken direct while a visit's year lowers the attention: load 2 over capacity 1, the warning, the receiver, three seasons

lord.estates.audit-pending.data: a visit's audit waiting for the lord's answer: what it found and the days left (the answer is the decision card's)

slot.ledger.lord-policy-subsidy.data: the ledger's lord tab with a subsidy on offer: the four policies with their icons, the subsidy's notice and its row

lord.region.data: the region map on the inherited state: the home direct, the inherited estate delegated to its steward (chosen, its line under the map), two neighbours; the map fitted

lord.region.zoomed.data: the region map at full zoom on the neighbour-suit state: the first neighbour chosen (its flag a neighbour's, the pieces the lord won of it listed), the map scrolled to it

modal.lord.will-change.data: the father's new will: favour (refused when the treasury is short), support promised, let it stand — the engine's numbers

modal.lord.contested.data: the contested inheritance: the rival's hold, the lord's suit stage, the way to the suit

modal.lord.audit.data: a Michaelmas audit's finding: punish, replace, tolerate with what each recovers and who follows

modal.lord.offmap-petition.data: an off-map estate's petition: why it came to the lord, both answers' treasury and goodwill
